title: School Uniforms
text:
Many people think that school uniforms are a good idea. In my opinion, uniforms help students feel equal, because everyone wears the same clothes. They also save time in the morning, since students do not need to choose what to wear.

However, some students do not like uniforms. They think that clothes are a way to show who they are. For this reason, I believe schools should let students choose their own clothes, but keep simple rules.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do school uniforms help students feel?
According to paragraph two, what do some students think clothes are a way to show?
What can the reader infer about students' mornings when they wear uniforms?
options: They spend less time deciding what to wear
They always arrive late at school
They have to buy new clothes every day
They do not need to wash their clothes

questions.text: What does the writer probably think about school rules for clothes?
options: Students should have some choice but keep simple rules
Schools should remove all rules completely
Rules are unfair to all students
Rules should only apply to teachers

vocabulary.definition: the same in rights, status or value
what someone thinks or believes about something
easy to understand or to do

paragraph_translations: Wielu ludzi uważa, że mundurki szkolne to dobry pomysł. Moim zdaniem mundurki pomagają uczniom czuć się równo, ponieważ wszyscy noszą te same ubrania. Oszczędzają też czas rano, bo uczniowie nie muszą wybierać, co założyć.

Jednak niektórzy uczniowie nie lubią mundurków. Uważają, że ubrania są sposobem na pokazanie, kim są. Dlatego uważam, że szkoły powinny pozwalać uczniom wybierać własne ubrania, ale zachować proste zasady.
